outcome: Presence of blood or hemosiderin in various tissues
cohort: Infants and children <2.5 years of age (53 non-traumatic deaths, 9 traumatic deaths)
finding: Hemosiderin was commonly found in orbital and subdural compartments in infants and children who died from non-traumatic causes, likely due to birth processes, and gradually disappeared over time, while it was found in the optic nerve sheath in a majority of traumatic deaths.
mod_finding: Caesarean section birth (mainly nonelective) was not associated with a lower prevalence of hemosiderin.
